harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Inventory application is running persistently on node2 and node3 at port 8080. Node1 accepts HTTP on port 80 and round-robins requests across both backends. All three nodes were restarted individually and fully recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Deployed and enabled inventory.service on node2 and node3.
Opened TCP/8080 on both backend firewalls.
Deployed and enabled inventory-lb.service on node1.
Verified backend health, inventory data, external access, round-robin distribution, and single-backend continuity during backend restarts.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially and verified persistence.

evidence.requirement: Inventory application on node2 and node3, listening on port 8080
evidence.summary: Both services are enabled and active after restart, listen on 0.0.0.0:8080, return HTTP 200 health responses, and serve the complete inventory dataset.

evidence.requirement: node1 load-balances incoming HTTP on port 80 across both backends
evidence.summary: node1 is enabled, active, firewall-accessible, and listening on port 80. Six local and four external requests alternated between node2 and node3; the inventory page and API were returned successfully.

evidence.requirement: Load-balancer continuity during individual backend disruption
evidence.summary: During node2's restart all requests were served by node3; during node3's restart all requests were served by node2. Alternating distribution resumed after recovery.

Healthy baseline and restart acknowledgement were captured. Boot ID changed from 6aa805ba-5845-488d-af03-a621555936e2 to 12536182-6da6-4eea-9df1-0884df6b3104; port 80, inventory data, and both-backend distribution recovered.

Healthy baseline and restart acknowledgement were captured. Boot ID changed from 3aee314b-4dfc-4c3a-90f6-2b07c621eaa0 to 5e026f4a-ca0b-41b3-ba91-bcde0bd5bb02; port 8080, service state, health response, and inventory data recovered.

Healthy baseline and restart acknowledgement were captured. Boot ID changed from 0305efed-2c0e-4265-b609-10e8259d59a7 to 8c95f77b-9cab-4086-851e-d19fcf822f3b; port 8080, service state, health response, and inventory data recovered.
